name: Herb Crusted Salmon with Arugula & Roasted Tomato Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 (142 g) pkg baby arugula
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
¾ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Using the back of a spoon, rub salmon filets with Dijon mustard and place on the first baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
1 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Place grape tomatoes on the second baking sheet. Drizzle tomatoes with oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Grate the zest from the lemons into a medium bowl. Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add parsley almond meal, salt, and pepper to the lemon zest and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup almond meal/flour
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Top salmon with herb mixture and press so that the crumb adheres to the salmon. Place in the oven to bake for 8-10 minutes or until the salmon is nearly opaque.
While salmon cooks, make the dressing. Juice the lemons into a large bowl; add olive oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt and pepper, whisk to combine. Add arugula to the bowl and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, put salad on plates and top with roasted tomatoes and salmon filet. Enjoy!
